Estudiantes del plantel, docentes y curiosos de la tecnología que quieran descubrir qué es la computación en la nube de una manera visual, divertida y cercana.

Partiremo dalla creazione di un singolo agente e ne estenderemo progressivamente le capacità: svilupperemo tool personalizzati, integreremo un server MCP (Model Context Protocol), introdurremo la comunicazione tra agenti tramite Agent-to-Agent (A2A) e costruiremo una interfaccia web per interagire con il sistema. Infine, ricostruiremo la stessa soluzione utilizzando Strands Harness, per vedere come cambia l’approccio allo sviluppo e all’orchestrazione.

Attraverso un progetto concreto, divertente e progressivo, esploreremo i principali building block dei sistemi agentici moderni e i pattern necessari per creare agenti, dotarli di strumenti e farli collaborare tra loro.

Al termine del workshop avrai sia le competenze pratiche sia i materiali necessari per poter riproporre l’esperienza in autonomia nella tua community.

description:
The AWS Women’s User Group Berlin is thrilled to invite you for an exciting session sponsored by AWS: Beyond the Prompt: Building, Deploying & Governing AI!

AI is changing the way we build things. With AI coding agents, turning an idea into a working application is easier than ever. But what happens next? How do you get your app online without spending a fortune? And how do we make sure AI solutions are ready for the real world and used responsibly?  
Join us for an evening of two interesting talks, practical examples and conversations around these questions.  
Building and hosting apps with AI: Learn how to take an AI-built application from your laptop to the cloud using AWS, keeping things simple, affordable and fully managed with Infrastructure as Code.  
Bringing agentic AI into the enterprise: Explore how enterprise platform patterns translate to agentic AI, what the EU AI Act means in practice, and how to approach Responsible AI.  
Whether you're experimenting with AI tools, building side projects, or working on enterprise AI solutions, we'd love to have you with us!

Speaker Info

Speaker: Sofiia Kalinina  
Position: DevOps Engineer at Gridfuse  
Talk Title: People actually use my vibe-coded app, and it costs me $10 a month on AWS

Abstract:  
Thanks to the ai coding agents we all suddenly became capable of building things - an internal tool I've always wanted at work, a small helper for a personal project, an app just to make my own life easier, you name it. I open the laptop, describe what I want, and a few evenings later the thing actually works on my machine. But then comes the tricky part - I want to share it with the world, and hosting the app becomes the next bottleneck. I hit exactly this with my language learning app useyourai.eu. (http://useyourai.eu./) I'm an infrastructure person, so I had three rules for myself: as cheap as possible, as easy as possible, and fully IaC so everything stays under my control. In this talk I'll tell you the story of how I got there: which AWS services I picked, which ones I dropped, and where the money actually goes. If you always thought AWS is too expensive or too complicated for a small side project, I'll prove otherwise.

Speaker: Mia Chang  
Position: Specialist Solutions Architect for Agentic AI at AWS  
Talk Title: From Digital Platform to Agentic AI Platform: EU AI Act, AI Sovereignty and Responsible AI in Practice

Abstract:  
In this session, attendees will learn how digital enterprise platform patterns, technical and operational, carry over to agentic AI platforms and what core building blocks they share. For example, identity, registry, and gateway. The session clarifies shared responsibility under the EU AI Act and shows how to turn regulation into best practices, with an use case walk through. It closes with reusable Responsible AI resources: a blog, a framework, and a skill for agents.

name: Building Platform-Agnostic AR/VR
description:
What happens when the headset you built for gets discontinued?

 

It's not a hypothetical. HoloLens is heading to end-of-life. Quest Pro is already there. Teams that built training programs, enterprise tools, or entire products around one specific piece of hardware are now staring down a rebuild not because their idea failed, but because the ground under it moved.

 

Oliver Edis (ReactVision) sits down with \[David, Pico] to talk through why ReactVision's Cloud Anchors and geospatial infrastructure are built device-agnostic on purpose so the experience survives even when the hardware underneath it doesn't. Real customer stories, not theory: what it actually looks like when a team has to choose between rebuilding from scratch or having architected for this from day one.

 

Presented by ReactVision.

Your work is the product. Your reputation is the signal. Join builders from across the AWS community for an evening of real connection, confidence and hands-on personal branding at HaSalon in The Palazzo.

Great work doesn't always get noticed on its own. This session is for anyone who's ever been the quiet expert in the room, wondered how to talk about their wins without it feeling like bragging, or wanted their impact to be seen as clearly as it's felt.

* Clarity on what you want to be known for, and the proof that backs it up
* Your own Brand Architecture Card, built using a Working Backwards exercise inspired by how Amazon builds products
* Honest feedback on how others see your work, so you can close the gap between how you're seen and how you want to be seen

* 6:15 PM | Architect your brand. Map yourself like an AWS architecture diagram, from your skills to what you're known for.

description: A hands-on workshop, run with AWS experts, on training your own model to beat a frontier model at a narrow task. Qué es una Watch & Build Party

No se trata únicamente de ver una transmisión en video. Una Watch & Build Party combina dos elementos fundamentales:

1. Watch: Analizamos los anuncios más relevantes presentados en Las Vegas durante re:Invent 2026, explicados en español claro, aterrizado y sin tecnicismos innecesarios.

* 10:00 - 10:20 | Bienvenida y registro: Apertura del evento, entrega de identificaciones y charla introductoria sobre el impacto de la tecnología en zonas rurales.
* 10:20 - 11:05 | Transmisión guiada de re:Invent: Proyección de los momentos clave del Keynote del Dr. Werner Vogels (CTO de Amazon) enfocado en cómo construir sistemas eficientes, sencillos y con propósito.
* 11:05 - 11:55 | Taller práctico guiado (Build Session): Despliegue de una primera arquitectura web serverless con AWS Lambda y Amazon S3 bajo la capa gratuita de AWS, implementando buenas prácticas de seguridad y permisos mínimos en IAM con asistencia de herramientas modernas de automatización.
* 11:55 - 12:30 | Networking, refrigerio y clausura: Convivencia con pizzas y bebidas, sesión de preguntas y respuestas, dinámicas de trivia técnica, entrega de obsequios oficiales de AWS re:Invent y orientación sobre rutas de certificación y becas de estudio.

Participación comunitaria e invitados especiales

Este evento reúne la colaboración de diversos programas del ecosistema oficial de Amazon Web Services:

* Anfitrión y organizador: AWS User Group Playa Vicente, representado por su fundador y líder comunitario Roberto Flores Segundo (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner y Lead Auditor ISO 27001:2022).
* Invitada técnica especial: Presencia y participación de Joselyn Lagunas (Shel), miembro del programa oficial AWS Community Builder, quien compartirá su experiencia sobre el aprendizaje continuo y las oportunidades en tecnología.

* Dirigido a: Estudiantes de bachillerato técnico, docentes del área de informática y personas interesadas en iniciarse en cloud.
* Requisitos técnicos: No se requiere experiencia previa en programación ni contar con tarjeta de crédito. Las prácticas se realizarán en los equipos del laboratorio con cuentas y créditos de prueba.
